notes: Cold email stays disabled until the separate direct-marketing compliance gate is documented. Belgian VAT identification must be completed before economic activity starts; owner input is triggered only once a genuine customer wants to proceed commercially.
first_customer_vat_trigger: First genuine external prospect who clearly wants to proceed with paid work
owner_vat_input_policy: Do not ask for VAT number before the first qualified customer signal. When that signal occurs, stop before paid quote/contract/payment and request the VAT prerequisite from the owner.
pre_vat_allowed: Research, qualification, passive/inbound informational responses, free preflight, proposal drafting, marketplace opportunity monitoring.
pre_vat_blocked: Paid proposal submission where it constitutes beginning economic activity, paid quote/contract, payment solicitation/acceptance, checkout activation, invoicing, paid fulfillment.
generic_b2b_route_scope: Belgian legal entities only; generic company/role mailboxes; high-fit PCFlows relevance; dedupe, suppression and opt-out required
activation_note: Do not enable before VAT/e604 commercial-activity gate is complete; re-check current Belgian rules at activation.
vat_number_handling: Private until a genuine external customer needs it for quote/contract/invoice; do not infer or publish the number.
outreach_activation: Pre-launch outreach may run now if the message clearly states official service start on 2026-10-01. Paid commercial execution starts no earlier than 2026-10-01.
pre_start_allowed: Research, qualification, buyer-demand monitoring, prospect validation, draft preparation, inbound non-binding responses, free preflight.
pre_start_blocked: Unsolicited promotional sending before the registered economic-activity start date, paid contract/payment/fulfillment.
prelaunch_outreach_scope: Clearly labeled pre-launch B2B advertising to verified generic legal-entity mailboxes; service availability explicitly starts 2026-10-01.
prelaunch_outreach_constraints: No misleading claim that service is already operational
Belgian B2B email rules, opt-out, dedupe, suppression and deliverability controls remain mandatory
